info.name: Maarkbh API
info.description:
Maarkbh multi-tenant API.

**Login:** use Auth â†’ Login (form-urlencoded). Tokens are saved automatically.

**Seeded users:**
- Tenant admin: `admin@demo.maarkbh.com` / `Admin@123`
- SuperAdmin: `admin@maarkbh.com` / `Admin@123`

request.description:
OpenIddict password grant. Body MUST be x-www-form-urlencoded (not JSON).

`username` accepts username or email.

ID2082 = wrong Content-Type
ID2029 = missing grant_type in form body
Platform SuperAdmin login (no tenant_id claim).
Requires Bearer token. For tenant users, tenant_id claim must match.

Requires Permissions.Customers.View

Requires Permissions.Customers.Create. fullNameAr is required; fullNameEn is optional. documents is optional: array of { documentType (1=IdentityDocument, 2=DrivingLicense, 3=Passport, 4=Other), fileId (from POST /api/attachments/upload), sortOrder }. identityType: 1=National, 2=Residence, 3=Visitor, 4=Gulf. Send the nested object matching identityType: national/residence = { beneficiaryIdNumber, hijriBirthDate?, birthDate?, isHijriBirthDate, email? } (isHijriBirthDate defaults true for National, false for Residence; when true send hijriBirthDate as an Umm al-Qura yyyymmdd integer, when false send Gregorian birthDate); visitor = { email, birthDate, borderNumber, passportNumber, licenseNumber, licenseExpiryDate, licenseIssuePlace, countryId, identityCopyNumber, identityExpiryDate }; gulf = same as visitor but with beneficiaryIdNumber instead of border/passport. birthDate is Gregorian and required for visitor/gulf (Tajeer requirement). After identity map, create calls POST /api/blacklist/check (best-effort). A verified network hit (2+ offices) auto-sets local IsBlacklisted with reason Blacklist.NetworkMatchReason; awaiting (1 office) does not. Response stays { id } — check GET customer for the flag.

Requires Permissions.Customers.Create. Visitor requires border/passport/license/country/identity-copy fields, Gregorian birthDate, and email. Same best-effort network blacklist check as National create (auto-flag only when verified).
Requires Permissions.Customers.View

Requires Permissions.AdditionalServices.View. Not paged. Active services offered at the given branch (empty branch list = all branches). Omit branchId to use the caller's visibility rule. Inaccessible branchId returns [].

Requires Permissions.Users.View. Returns paged results. Optional `isActive` (true/false) filters by account status.
Requires Permissions.Users.View. Returns a single tenant user with role and branch assignments.

Requires Permissions.Users.Create.

`userName` is required and unique (used for login).
`phoneNumber` is optional; when provided must be Saudi mobile `9665XXXXXXXX`.
`roleName` must be the Identity name from Roles → Lookup (e.g. sales_lead_1), not the display name.

Requires Permissions.Users.Edit. TenantAdmin user cannot be modified from tenant API.

`userName` must remain unique when changed.
`phoneNumber`: omit to leave unchanged, empty string to clear, or Saudi mobile `9665XXXXXXXX`.
Requires Permissions.Users.Edit. Sets IsActive=true. 204 if already active. Cannot toggle TenantAdmin. Does not delete the user.

Requires Permissions.Users.Edit. Sets IsActive=false. 204 if already inactive. Blocks self-deactivate (User.CannotDeactivateSelf) and TenantAdmin (User.Protected). New login/refresh is rejected with Auth.AccountDisabled.
Requires Permissions.Users.Edit. Sets a new password without the current one. Cannot reset TenantAdmin. Password must be at least 8 characters and include a digit.
